changelog:
- Initial release of zentao-tour.
- Provides an interactive onboarding experience for ZenTao and zentao-cli in a conversational, colleague-like style.
- Guides users based on their role (Product Manager, Project Manager, Tester, Developer, Executive) with real environment walkthroughs.
- Emphasizes a friendly, non-tutorial tone, guiding users naturally through features without rigid steps or checklists.
- Supports troubleshooting and error explanations in plain, approachable language.
- Enables users to explore, ask questions, and clean up demo data easily at any time.
